records.context: The third renderer of the same frame: Vulkan, Metal or Direct3D 12 by the adapter it is given. The same rays (:class:`VolumeRays`), renderings, finishes and lens as :func:`render_volume` and :class:`GLVolumeRenderer`; one compute invocation walks one ray. Volumes are read with ``textureLoad`` and interpolated in the shader exactly as :func:`scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates` does (``order=1``, edges repeated), image layers add up, labels layers are laid over them in stack order, and each labels layer writes the object nearest the viewer under each ray for picking. The frame is drawn into a storage buffer, scaled to the picture's size and read back, so it lands under the same matplotlib axes as the CPU's.
records.label: spacr.layers.WGPUVolumeRenderer#1
records.source: The third renderer of the same frame: Vulkan, Metal or Direct3D 12 by the adapter it is given. The same rays (:class:`VolumeRays`), renderings, finishes and lens as :func:`render_volume` and :class:`GLVolumeRenderer`; one compute invocation walks one ray. Volumes are read with ``textureLoad`` and interpolated in the shader exactly as :func:`scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates` does (``order=1``, edges repeated), image layers add up, labels layers are laid over them in stack order, and each labels layer writes the object nearest the viewer under each ray for picking. The frame is drawn into a storage buffer, scaled to the picture's size and read back, so it lands under the same matplotlib axes as the CPU's.
records.translation: Þriðji teiknarinn fyrir sama myndramma: Vulkan, Metal eða Direct3D 12 eftir því hvaða grafíkmillistykki hann fær. Sömu geislar (:class:`VolumeRays`), teikniaðferðir, yfirborðsáferð og linsa og í :func:`render_volume` og :class:`GLVolumeRenderer`; hver útreikningskeyrsla fer eftir einum geisla. Þrívíð gögn eru lesin með ``textureLoad`` og brúuð í skyggingarforritinu nákvæmlega eins og :func:`scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates` gerir (``order=1``, jaðargildi endurtekin). Myndlög eru lögð saman, merkjalög lögð yfir þau í staflaröð og hvert merkjalag skráir hlutinn næst áhorfandanum eftir hverjum geisla til að hægt sé að velja hluti. Myndramminn er teiknaður í geymslubiðminni, stærð hans aðlöguð að myndinni og hann lesinn aftur, svo hann birtist á sömu matplotlib-ásum og myndramminn frá CPU.
